name: Aspen
description: Aspen is a smaller, fluffy fellow who just had what was likely his very first grooming — and he looks and feels so much better. Despite not having had the best start in life, he is incredibly sweet and gentle. He’s currently in a play group with other dogs and is adjusting beautifully now that he’s out of the shelter and into a more stable routine. If you’d like to foster or adopt Aspen, please reach out. This sweet boy is ready for love and would truly appreciate a safe, caring home.

name: Auspicious
description: Auspicious — can we talk about how perfectly named this dog is? He is so gorgeous, sweet, shy, and friendly that we barely worry about the few things he still needs to learn, like leash manners and hopping into the car. This big boy has more personality and love in his little toe than many folks in their entire body. Auspicious is fully vetted and weighs about 68 pounds. He is pure charm inside and out and will absolutely steal your heart. In the car, he gently rests his chin on your shoulder while you pet him — and he literally purrs. Yes, purrs. It’s impossible not to melt. He loves kisses and attention. A completely adorable, affectionate, and beautiful soul, Auspicious is a lovable and LARGE goofball who will have you falling hard in no time.

name: Blanca
description: Blanca has personality for DAYS . This husky mixie just turned 1 year old—and she’s bringing the looks and the fun. All-white coat. Golden eyes. Fully grown and perfectly fun-sized at just under 40 lbs. ✔️ Crate trained ✔️ Potty trained ✔️ Highly treat motivated (aka ready to learn all the things) Blanca absolutely adores humans and gets along with most dogs. But what she really wants? Her person. Her home. Her whole world. If you’re looking for a loyal sidekick, endless laughs, and a whole lot of personality… Blanca might just be your girl.

name: Blast
description: Blast – Your Daily Dose of Happiness You would never expect a dog this beautiful, this smart, and this loving (with a serious appreciation for attention ) to come from the streets—but Blast did. He was living with two unhoused humans in a sequence, when a kind person noticed him and reached out to Norsled. How could we possibly say no? Blast is now fully vetted, gloriously fluffy, and showing the world who he really is. He’s already a solid 60 pounds, and still growing into both his body and his bright future. Life on the streets didn’t give him much formal training, but what it did give him is resilience—and wow, does he want to please. He’s smart, eager, and absolutely ready to become someone’s best dog ever. He will definitely need a human to be his sidekick and mentor as full time as possible. Life on the street was strange, scary and a "support human" would make his life complete. Meet him and you won’t be sad. You might be smitten. Appropriately named, Blast truly is a blast: joyful, affectionate, and so much fun to be around. Come meet him and see for yourself. ---

name: Blaze
description: Blaze is a 2 yr old boy that has already survived more than most dogs ever will. After an accident, one of his rear legs had to be amputated. He adjusted immediately and lives life with the same joy, confidence, and gentle spirit as any other dog. He's also big, weighing 60 lbs. Blaze is a tall, handsome husky with stunning blue eyes and the sweetest old soul. He’s calm, affectionate - and has a kind, quiet presence. ✔️Crate trained ✔️ Potty trained ✔️ Dog-friendly ✔️ Fully healed ✔️ All vetted Blaze doesn’t need someone to feel sorry for him. He just needs someone to see him for who he is: an incredible dog who happens to have three legs.

name: Blue
description: Blue — Distinguished, Devoted, and Ready for His Next Chapter Blue is a 67‑lb handsome gentleman with the heart (and teeth!) of a much younger dog. Don’t let that “8” fool you — this boy still has plenty of sparkle. He’s active, playful, and every bit the classic Husky escape artist, with that spirited glint in his eye that says, “Adventure? I’m in.” Once he’s settled, though, Blue is wonderfully chill and easygoing. He’s strong, steady, and well‑mannered — the kind of dog who brings a calming presence into the home while still being up for fun. Blue’s social style: Gets along well with other dogs with proper introductions Equally content being your one‑and‑only Calm, respectful, and beautifully behaved in the home His dream life is simple and sweet: a calm home, a comfy bed, and some nice casual walks with his person. He doesn’t need chaos or constant activity — just someone who appreciates a mature Husky who still has plenty of spark left to share. Blue is looking for a Husky‑savvy foster or adopter, and he’s available for foster‑to‑adopt, the perfect way to see if he’s your match. He’s fully vetted, healthy, and has so much life, love, and sweetness to give. This is truly one very special boy. Blue is ready for his next chapter — maybe it’s with you.
traits: Gets along well with other dogs with proper introductions

name: Bob
description: Meet Bob — Big, Beautiful, and Even Better! ❤️ Meet Bob , an impressive 101 pounds of love, fun, and companionship . This magnificent boy is wrapped in the most gorgeous, fluffy coat, and those adorable “raccoon eyes” make him even more charming and irresistible. He's also completely vetted and ready for action. Bob absolutely loves being with people. He has attended adoption fairs and other Norsled events and has been a model citizen at every spot. He’s the kind of dog who makes friends wherever he goes—and since arriving at Norsled, he has made a LOT of them . At around 5- 6 years old , Bob may be considered a mature gentleman, but he certainly doesn’t act like life is slowing down. He thinks age is just a number and is ready for more adventures, more fun, and a whole lot more love .

name: Buck
description: Buck is a handsome Husky/Malamute mix with a big heart, a happy personality, and plenty of love to give. Buck’s story began when a Good Samaritan found him wandering in October 2024. She brought him to the shelter hoping his family would come looking for him. When no one did, she stepped up again and brought him to safety. Since then, she has had him neutered, arranged training, and given him the structure, stability, and love he needed. And Buck has come a long way. Once an energetic teenage boy, Buck has mellowed considerably. He is a very good-natured, affectionate dog who absolutely loves people: men, women, children, and seniors alike. He’s a happy boy who enjoys his walks, loves treats, and is eager to please. Buck currently lives successfully with two other dogs and is even submissive to the female dog in the home. He can be reactive to unfamiliar small dogs while out on walks, so he will benefit from an experienced adopter who understands northern breeds and will continue working with him. He has also shown some resource guarding in the past, but this behavior has improved immensely with training, consistency, and structure. At 67 pounds, Buck is a big, beautiful boy who is absolutely stunning in person. He has so much personality and has already shown just how much he can learn and grow with the right guidance. Buck’s guardian angel has given him everything she can. Now he needs the one thing she can’t give him - a permanent home of his own. Buck is fully vetted and ready to find his forever family.

name: Cinder
description: This woolly, blue-eyed beauty first came to NorSled in early 2025 after being found as a stray in the Bakersfield area. She was adopted, but sadly, her owner passed away, and Cinder is back with us looking for another family to love. She’s as sweet as ever - just a little more “huskier” these days! Cinder is a gentle girl with a loving nature and lovely manners. She knows sit, shake and down, walks well on a leash, is crate trained and learns quickly. She’s also done wonderfully at adoption events. Cinder is fully vetted and ready for a foster or forever home where she can feel safe, settled and loved again. Fostering-to-adopt is a wonderful way to see if she’s the right match for your family and lifestyle.

name: Cloud
description: Meet Cloud – Your Easygoing Best Friend! ☁️❤️ Looking for a mellow, easygoing companion? Meet Cloud, an adorable young pup who is ready to leave his past behind and start the best chapter of his life. Cloud is approximately 1 year old and weighs about 45 pounds. He has the sweetest, gentlest personality and loves being part of whatever his people are doing. Whether it's a car ride, a walk around the neighborhood, or simply relaxing at home, Cloud is happiest spending time with his family. This handsome boy is still young and will benefit from continued training, but he is eager to learn and already shows wonderful natural manners. He walks nicely on leash, enjoys riding in the car, and isn't much of a barker. His calm, affectionate temperament makes him a joy to be around. Cloud's story began in difficult circumstances. He was rescued after spending much of his life chained to a fence in a rural California town with very little care. Despite that heartbreaking start, Cloud has never lost his loving spirit. He greets people with kindness, trusts easily, and seems grateful for every bit of attention he receives. One of Cloud's most endearing features is his adorable floppy ears. They likely became that way after untreated ear infections as a puppy, but they only make him more unique and impossibly cute. Cloud is now completely vetted, healthy, and ready for his forever home. All he needs is a family who will include him in their adventures, continue showing him the love he has always deserved, and let him discover just how wonderful life can be. If you're searching for a gentle, loyal companion with a heart as big as his smile, Cloud is waiting to meet you.
